descriptions.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]推断[From.From.GetName]被当做星际墓地来使用的，许多外星种群都死在了那里。尸体则在重力的作用下经过数百万年的时间慢慢的被拉向气态巨行星。这种古老的循环在一千五百万年前最后一批生物到达后突然的中断了。我们只能推测可能它们是被其他的太空生物所猎杀，或者遇到了天灾。
descriptions.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has deduced that [From.From.GetName] served as an orbital graveyard, where members of the dead alien species we found came to die. Gravity took care of the rest, slowly pulling the remains into the gas giant over a period of millions of years.

This ancient cycle seems to have stopped abruptly 15 million years ago when the last creature arrived. We can only speculate as to whether they were hunted to extinction by spacefaring civilizations or met their end through some other calamity.

descriptions.zh: 对[From.GetName]进行深度扫描显示，覆盖表层的冰幔下面有很多水暖阀口，这些阀口将一整片大洋加热。首席[Owner.GetScientist][Root.GetLeaderName]从[Root.GetName]派遣了探测器，这些探测器钻透了几里厚的冰层，发现了地下的水体里面充满了生命。我们需要更多的资源进行一次彻底的研究，探查居住在这片深洋里的诸多生命形式。
descriptions.en: Deep scans of [From.GetName] have revealed a large ocean heated by hydrothermal vents beneath the ice mantle covering the surface. Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] dispatched probes from the [Root.GetName] that drilled through several miles of thick ice and found the water below teeming with what appears to be life. We will need more resources to conduct a thorough study of the many unique life forms inhabiting this ocean.

descriptions.zh: 首席[Owner.GetScientist][Root.GetLeaderName]已经从探险中返回，结束了对[From.From.GetName]冰下之海中的丰富生物圈的调查。在大海的底层区域，科研人员发现了几种大型原生物种，它们能产生一种独特的无机分子，具有十分神奇的疗养性质。如果这种分子能够被成功地大量采集，它将会掀起医疗科学领域的一场革命，甚至可能出现产业规模的应用！
descriptions.en: Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] has returned from the expedition that studied the rich biosphere in the seas beneath the ice mantle of [From.From.GetName]. Several large species native to the lower regions of the global sea have been found to produce a unique, inorganic molecule with immense healing properties. If this molecule is successfully harvested in large enough quantities, it could revolutionize the field of medical science, and may even have industrial applications!

descriptions.zh:
首席[Owner.GetScientist][Root.GetLeaderName]已经从探险中返回，结束了对[From.From.GetName]冰下之海中的生物圈的调查。在大海的底层区域，我们发现了几种大型原生物种，它们能产生一种独特的无机分子，具有十分神奇的疗养性质。

如果这种分子能够被成功地大量采集，它将会让我们对最亲爱的活体陈设的医疗看护产生革命性的变化，甚至可能出现产业规模的应用！
descriptions.en:
Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] has returned from the expedition that studied the biosphere in the seas beneath the ice mantle of [From.From.GetName]. Several large species native to the lower regions of the global sea have been found to produce a unique, inorganic molecule with immense healing properties.

If this molecule is successfully harvested in large enough quantities, it could revolutionize medical care for our beloved bio-trophies, and may even have industrial applications!

descriptions.zh: 首席[Owner.GetScientist][Root.GetLeaderName]已经完成了对[From.From.GetName]冰层下海洋中丰富生物圈的考察任务。我们的水下探测器已经绘制了地形图，并记录了大部分生命形式。虽然这些数据可能对我们的生物学家有些用处，但除此之外并未发现任何具有特殊应用价值的东西。
descriptions.en: Lead [Owner.GetScientist] [Root.GetLeaderName] has returned from the expedition that studied the rich biosphere in the seas beneath the ice mantle of [From.From.GetName]. Our underwater probes have mapped the terrain and cataloged most of the life forms. Although this data may be of some use to our biologists, no particular discoveries have been made that would have any applications beyond that.

descriptions.zh:
我们先前以为[From.GetName]的南半球地区有一座山脉，其实这是一个巨型外星生物的庞大骨架。

这副骨架已经有三十四亿年的历史了，但我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为在这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]的任何历史节点上，[From.GetName]的环境都无法支持这么大体型生命体的生存。[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]正在准备新的研究计划，进一步探究其中的奥秘。
descriptions.en:
What was previously thought to be assorted mountains in the southern hemisphere of [From.GetName] have been identified as the massive skeletal remains of a single colossal alien life form.

The bones have been dated as 3.4 billion years old, but our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have ruled out that [From.GetName] could have supported life on that scale at any point in the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s history. [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] has prepared a special research project to delve further into this mystery.

label.zh: 我们可能会学到一种新的灭绝方式。
label.en: We might learn a new method of extermination.

label.zh: 我们能让它再次动起来吗？
label.en: Can we make it move again?

descriptions.zh: 根据对[From.From.GetName]上巨型骨骼遗骸的分析，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]得出结论：这种生物是被作为某种飞船而使用的。在巨型的骨骼中至少发现了三种不同种群生物的骨骼，我们推断这些骨骼是属于该船船员的。出于未知原因，这艘生物飞船遭受了极为严重的损伤，坠毁在了[From.From.GetName]。虽说我们根本无法理解需要何等水平的生物工程才能“培养”出这样巨大的飞船，但单单对其骨骼的研究就已令我们的科技获得了巨大的进步。
descriptions.en:
After continued studies of the massive skeletal remains found on [From.From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has concluded that the creature served as some kind of organic starship. Much smaller bones from at least three separate species were found within the larger skeleton, and we assume these came from members of the crew.

For unknown reasons, this organic starship suffered catastrophic damage and crash-landed on [From.From.GetName]. While we cannot begin to understand the biological engineering necessary to "grow" a starship like this, the study of these bones alone has substantially advanced our knowledge.

descriptions.zh:
在对[From.From.GetName]上的巨大骨架进行深入研究后，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]肯定了最不可能的可能：这原来是一艘活体舰船。该生物与我们自己的生物舰船拥有一些相似性。

它的结构既熟悉又陌生，令人无比惊奇，仿佛是被截然不同的演化哲学所塑造而成。在其巨大的胸腔中还发现了一些至少属于三种不同物种的小型骨架，暗示它可能曾在体内搭载船员。这种概念令人不太舒服，因为我们自己的生物舰船是共生的，而不是能塞进人的中空船。

其死亡原因尚不清楚，但受到的伤害是灾难性的，它巨大的骨架在坠落星球表面时摔碎了。它的船员或者说什么更高级的引导智能究竟只是与它一同死去，还是其自我无可分割的一部分？

虽然我们可能永远无法完全解开它起源的谜题，但对其遗骸的研究使我们对活体舰船的意义有了更深入的理解。然而，一个令人不安的问题挥之不去：它是被创造出来的……或者它是生来如此？
descriptions.en:
After extensive study of the colossal skeletal remains on [From.From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has confirmed the impossible: this was once a living starship. This creature bore little resemblance to our own biological vessels.

Its structure is bizarre, both familiar and alien, as if shaped by an entirely different evolutionary philosophy. Smaller bones, belonging to at least three distinct species, were found nestled within its massive ribcage, suggesting it once carried a crew inside its very body. A disturbing notion, given that our own ships are symbiotic, not hollow vessels to be inhabited.

The cause of death is unclear, but the damage is catastrophic, its massive frame shattered as it plummeted to the planet's surface. Did its crew die with it, or were they something more - a guiding intelligence, inseparable from the being itself?

Though we may never fully unravel its origins, the study of its remains has advanced our understanding of what it means to be a living ship. And yet, an unsettling question lingers: Was it created... or was it born?

label.zh: 先吃飞行员还是先吃飞船？
label.en: Do we start by consuming the pilots or the ship?

descriptions.zh: 我们对[From.From.GetName]上巨型骨骼遗骸进行持续研究后，渐渐搞清了这个生物为何会流落到[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]。在骸骨的尾部，我们侦测到了十分细微的残余能源读数，证明在这个位置曾打开过某种空间传送门。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为，这个生物是从其他空间穿越这道传送门后来到这里，并很快由于[From.From.GetName]严酷环境的侵袭而死亡。它为何来到这里，或是从何而来，都将成为永远的无解之谜。
descriptions.en:
Our continued studies of the massive skeletal remains on [From.From.GetName] have managed to shed some light on how the creature ended up on the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]. There are very faint residual energy readings that indicate some kind of dimensional portal existed briefly towards the rear of the skeleton.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] theorizes that the creature passed through this gateway from another dimension only to quickly perish in the hostile environment of [From.From.GetName]. Why it did this and where it came from are questions that may never be answered.

label.zh: 管它来自哪个次元，DNA就是DNA！
label.en: No matter its dimension of origin, DNA is DNA!

descriptions.zh: 这堆骸骨再次移动了起来！巨兽高高地越过我们的死灵法师，迈出摇摇晃晃的第一步，接着是第二步，然后是稳当当地一步接一步。它可能没有生前一样数量的腿，或者数目正确的附肢。我们混合使用了实验室培养的肌肉和工艺水平的液压替代装置，现在这只巨兽已经准备在任何战场上支援我们的战斗，想必它足下的大地必将震颤。
descriptions.en: The skeletal remains are moving once more! The behemoth towers above our necromancers as it takes a shaky stride, followed by another, more steady, one. It might not have the same amount of legs it had in life or the correct number of appendages. Using a mix of lab-grown muscles as well as state-of-the-art hydraulic replacements, the Giant is ready to aid us on any battlefield, and the earth below its feet shall tremble.

tooltips.zh: 轨道上增加§G1§!支§Y骸骨巨兽陆军§!。

descriptions.zh: 五千年前的某段时间，[From.GetName]的近地轨道上发生了一次大规模的太空战役。[From.GetPlanetMoon]的一侧地表上到处都是武器打偏留下的打击坑。对[Root.GetName]的扫描显示地表存在一些遗骸。虽然这些破损飞船的保存状况都很差，但历经数千年这些飞船还能留下一些东西就足以证明了它们的设计是非常尖端的。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]正在组织一次考察行动，考察的目的是通过盘查这些古老舰体来寻找一些有价值的科技。
descriptions.en:
There is clear evidence that a massive space battle took place in close orbit of [From.GetName] at some point in the last 5,000 years. The surface on one side of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is pockmarked with craters from stray weapons blasts, and scans from the [Root.GetName] have picked up several hulks on the ground.

Though these wrecked ships are all in very poor condition, the fact that anything remains at all after the damage they must have sustained is a testament to their advanced design. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is preparing an expedition to sift through these derelict hulls for any valuable technologies.

descriptions.zh:
证据毋庸置疑地证明在过去的5000年内，[From.GetName]的上空曾经发生过一场活体舰船的巨兽之战。[From.GetPlanetMoon]的地表烙印着深深的伤痕——垂死的生物舰船从轨道上坠落，产生巨大的撞击坑，它们残破的外壳在撞击中如过熟的水果一般迸裂。即使到现在，干燥已久的有机残留物和软骨化石仍残留在支离破碎的地面上。

这些雄伟生物的生物结构被岁月扭曲石化，其遗骸几乎无法辨认。然而，经过数千年的腐烂和暴露，竟然还有东西能幸存下来，这已经说明了它们的非凡韧性。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]正准备考察这些巨兽化石，以期能发现它们基因结构或生物工程共生体的残余；这些秘密中可能仍在潜伏着生命的脉搏。
descriptions.en:
There is irrefutable evidence that a titanic battle of living starships once took place in the skies above [From.GetName], sometime in the last 5,000 years. The surface of the [From.GetPlanetMoon] bears deep scars - vast impact craters where dying vessels plummeted from orbit, their ruptured husks bursting like overripe fruit upon collision. Even now, traces of long-dried organic residue and fossilized cartilage linger in the blasted terrain.

The remains of these once-majestic creatures are barely recognizable, their bio-structures twisted and petrified by time. Yet the fact that anything endures at all after millennia of decay and exposure speaks to their remarkable resilience. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is preparing an expedition to examine these fossilized leviathans, hoping to uncover remnants of their genetic architecture or bio-engineered symbiotes; secrets that may still pulse with dormant life.

descriptions.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]领导的队伍已完成了对[From.From.GetName]的探索，回到了[Root.GetName]。可喜的是，地表上的飞船墓地中包含着大量的先进科技，可供我们探索。其中包含的科技我们尚未完全发掘完毕，但对这些飞船遗骸的研究已令我们数个领域的科技水平前进了数年之巨。若能在轨道上建立永久的科学站，将对我们的飞船工程水平提供极大的帮助。
descriptions.en:
The team under Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has finished their expedition on [From.From.GetName] and returned to the [Root.GetName]. Thankfully, the starship graveyard on the surface proved to be a technological treasure trove.

Studying the remains of these vessels has advanced our research in certain fields by several years, and there are yet things to discover. A permanent science outpost in orbit would be a great boon to our starship engineering efforts.

descriptions.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]领导的队伍已完成了对[From.From.GetName]的探索，回到了[Root.GetName]。遗憾的是，地表那些坠毁的飞船损毁过于严重，未能回收任何可用的科技。然而，我们可以明显看出这些飞船极为先进，若对其结构和设计进行分析，它们将会为我们提供宝贵的工程知识。我们应该考虑在此轨道上建造一座永久的科学站。
descriptions.en:
The team under Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has finished their expedition on [From.From.GetName] and returned to the [Root.GetName]. Sadly, the wrecked starships on the surface were too badly damaged to recover any useful technologies.

These vessels were clearly very advanced, however, and we could gain valuable engineering insights if we analyze the way they were designed. We should consider the construction of a permanent science outpost in orbit.

descriptions.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的团队完成了[From.From.GetName]上的悲惨探险现已返回[Root.GetName]。不幸的是，时间对这具古老的有机遗骸并不仁慈。其的结死亡构不是早已石化就是变成易碎的钙化外壳，几乎没有立即修复的价值。

然而，即使已经死亡，它们的设计也超越了我们目前的理解。它们生物工程骨骼的复杂晶格、曾经活跃的肌肉组织的残余，以及远远超出我们自己理解的神经结构的痕迹，都表明其中的复杂技术仍需要进一步研究。在轨道上建立一座永久的研究基地可能是解开这些早已灭绝的庞然大物秘密的关键。
descriptions.en:
The team under Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has completed their harrowing expedition on [From.From.GetName] and returned to the [Root.GetName]. Unfortunately, time has not been kind to the remains of these ancient, organic vessels. Their once-living structures have long since fossilized or crumbled into brittle, calcified husks, leaving little of immediate value to recover.

Yet even in death, their design speaks of wonders beyond our current understanding. The intricate lattice of their bio-engineered skeletons, the vestigial remains of once-reactive musculature, and the traces of a neural architecture far beyond our own comprehension, all suggest a level of technological sophistication that demands further study. Establishing a permanent research presence in orbit may be the key to unraveling the secrets of these long-extinct leviathans.

descriptions.zh: 在对[From.GetName]的地表进行扫描时，[Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]发现了人工雕刻的石板，上面写着外星文字。[From.GetPlanetMoon]上没有侦测到其他的外星活动，这个壁画究竟是如何到这里来的仍然是个谜。我们接下来就准备着手进行破译工作。
descriptions.en: While conducting surface scans of [From.GetName], [Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] aboard the [Root.GetName] discovered what appears to be an artificially carved slab of rock covered in alien writing. No other signs of alien activity on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] have been detected, and exactly how this mural came to be here is a mystery. We have prepared a special project to translate the text.

descriptions.zh:
[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]已经部分破译了[From.From.GetName]上发现的外星壁画。它是为了纪念一个曾在本地区建立过一个小型星际帝国的已灭亡外星种族。很明显消灭他们的人就是这幅壁画的作者，他们似乎很后悔这个决定。

鉴于这幅壁画已经有三亿多年的历史了，它的作者很可能也已灭绝。或许最有趣的是这幅壁画的材料——尽管历史久远，但保存的却依然非常完好。
descriptions.en:
[Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] has managed to partially translate the alien mural discovered on [From.From.GetName]. It is a memorial for an extinct alien race that once maintained a small interstellar empire in this region of the galaxy. They were apparently exterminated by the creators of the mural, a fact that they seem to regret.

Given that the mural has been dated to be in excess of 300 million years old, it is likely that its creators are also extinct by now. Perhaps most interesting of all is the material that the mural was made of - despite its age, it is in remarkably good condition.

descriptions.zh:
[Owner.GetScientistCapital][Root.GetLeaderName]已经部分破译了[From.From.GetName]的外星壁画。其中包含了大量的数据，因此这幅壁画很可能是某种简陋的图书馆。壁画中大致记载了八千万年前统治这片区域的外星文明收集到的所有科技知识。

大多数知识我们已经知晓，但数据中仍有一些非常有启发性的科技信息。这里的数据够科学家研究上几十年的，因此需要设立一个轨道研究设施来继续进行翻译的工作。
descriptions.en:
[Owner.GetScientistCapital] [Root.GetLeaderName] has managed to partially translate the alien mural discovered on [From.From.GetName]. The text contains a staggering amount of data, and the mural evidently serves as some sort of low-tech library. It describes, in broad terms, the collected technological knowledge of an alien civilization that dominated this region of the galaxy some 80 million years ago.

A lot of it is already known to us, but the data does contain several promising leads for technologies we had yet to consider. There is enough data here to keep our scientists busy for decades, but we will need an orbital research facility to continue the translation efforts.

descriptions.zh:
在对[From.GetName]进行调查时，[Root.GetName]检测到轨道中有一个自动化船坞的残骸。这个船坞至少有一千年的历史了，并且曾经被重型导弹轮番轰炸过，所幸的是其中一个船坞仍可以使用。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]确信能够恢复船坞的电力，但过程会比较复杂。
descriptions.en:
While conducting their survey of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] detected the remains of an automated shipyard in orbit. It is at least a thousand years old and seems to have been subjected to a heavy missile barrage, but one of its manufacturing bays is still in working condition.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is confident that power can be restored to the shipyard, but it would be a significant project.

descriptions.zh:
在调查[From.GetName]的过程中，[Root.GetName]有了个惊人的发现：一个古老而凋败的太空孕育摇篮的遗迹；这是一座巨大的有机结构，它曾经可以制造星际飞船。它在寂静中漂流，外膜破裂萎缩，这似乎是在几个世纪前的残酷轰炸中发生的。它的大部分管路组织都石化了，神经网络没有反应……然而，还有一个孕育室仍在微弱地蠕动着，它的反应堆缓慢地跳动着剩余的生命。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]相信，只要小心地介入，我们也许可以复活这个沉睡的生命，至少部分复活。然而，这会是一件颇费时间的工程，不可预见的生物响应风险也不能忽视。
descriptions.en:
While surveying [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] has made an astonishing discovery: the decayed remains of an ancient, spaceborne gestation cradle; a vast organic structure once capable of birthing starships. It drifts in silence, its outer membranes ruptured and withered from what appears to have been a brutal bombardment, likely centuries ago. Most of its vascular conduits are petrified, its neural lattice unresponsive... and yet, one gestation chamber still stirs faintly, its reactors sluggishly pulsing with residual life.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] believes that, with careful intervention, we may be able to revive this slumbering entity, at least partially. However, it will be a delicate and time-consuming process, and the risk of unforeseen biological responses cannot be ignored.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetFleetName]成功恢复了[From.From.From.GetName]上自动化造船厂的电力。船厂很快就恢复了之前被中断的生产程序，使用现有的材料建造了三艘结构未知的掠袭者战舰。

可惜在这之后这个古老的造船厂发生了无法修复的严重故障。因此我们只能选择接管这三艘飞船，让其加入我们的舰队。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetFleetName] has successfully restored power to the automated shipyard over [From.From.From.GetName]. The facility immediately resumed its interrupted construction order, using what materials it had on hand to build three advanced raiders of an unknown design.

Unfortunately, the ancient facility broke down completely afterwards and has been deemed beyond repair. We have sent crews to the new ships and commissioned them into our fleet.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetFleetName]成功复苏了围绕着[From.From.From.GetName]的休眠摇篮。常年闲置的生物锻造器突然复苏使这个古老的有机结构颤抖起来，它匆忙地完成了三头战兽的生长周期，它们的设计都是未知的，但却异常复杂。

然而，这种意想不到的重生对这个衰老的有机体来说，压力太大了。它的维管崩溃，神经中枢枯萎，溶解成惰性的生物质。新组建的舰队虽然一开始迷失了方向，但很快便适应了我们的存在。它们被整合进我们的舰队，迫不及待地为新的共生主体建功立业了。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetFleetName] has successfully reawakened the dormant cradle orbiting [From.From.From.GetName]. The ancient, organic structure trembled as its long-idle bio-forges surged to life, hastily completing the growth cycle of three warforms, each an unknown yet eerily sophisticated design.

However, the strain of this unexpected rebirth proved too much for the aged organism. Its vascular conduits collapsed, its neural core withered, and it dissolved into inert biomass. The newly formed ships, though disoriented at first, quickly adapted to our presence. They have been integrated into our fleet, eager to serve their new symbiotic masters.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetFleetName]成功恢复了[From.From.From.GetName]上自动化造船厂的电力。船厂很快就恢复了之前被中断的生产程序，使用现有的材料建造了一艘结构未知的炮艇。

可惜在这之后这个古老的造船厂发生了无法修复的严重故障。因此我们只能选择接管这艘飞船，让其加入我们的舰队。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetFleetName] has successfully restored power to the automated shipyard over [From.From.From.GetName]. The facility immediately resumed its interrupted construction order, using what materials it had on hand to build an advanced frigate of unknown design.

Unfortunately, the ancient facility broke down completely afterwards and has been deemed beyond repair. We have sent a crew to the new ship and pressed it into service with our fleet.

descriptions.zh: 对[From.GetName]的深度扫描显示这颗气态巨行星的大气层中有一艘大型飞船。根据附近的碎片看，过去曾经有人试图回收它，但都失败了。任何足以抵挡如此强大引力的飞船都是非常珍贵的。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提出了自己的回收计划。
descriptions.en: Active scans of [From.GetName] have picked up what appears to be a large ship deep inside the atmosphere of the gas giant. Judging by the nearby debris, there have been several failed attempts to salvage this derelict in the past. Any ship strong enough to withstand such crushing gravity must be a magnificent prize, and Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has proposed a salvage project of our own.

label.en: Bring it up, whatever it is.
The effort is too great. Leave it down there.

descriptions.zh: 运用无与伦比的大师级工程技术，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]和他的小队成功将[From.From.GetName]上被遗弃的飞船升到了高层大气中。尽管年久失修，这个古老的巡洋舰依然比较完好，系统在供能之后依然运转正常。不清楚原有的船员下落如何，但我们依然派遣了新的船员，并让其加入了我们的舰队。
descriptions.en: In a masterful display of engineering, the team under Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has managed to gently raise the derelict ship on [From.From.GetName] to the gas giant's upper atmosphere. Despite its age, the ancient cruiser is in remarkably good condition and we have restored power to its systems. No trace of the original crew remains, but we have brought over our own and commissioned the ship into the fleet.

descriptions.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]试图将[From.From.GetName]大气层中的飞船回收的计划失败了。星球的强引力使得我们的一艘工程拖船引擎熄火，并与这艘被遗弃的飞船撞在了一起。几个人因此丧命，那艘飞船也进而被拖进了大气层的深处-我们对此无能为力了。
descriptions.en: The attempt by Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] to salvage the derelict ship from the atmosphere of [From.From.GetName] was a failure. The gas giant's heavy gravity disabled the engines of one of our engineering tugs, which then collided with the derelict. Several lives were lost, and the ancient vessel was pushed even deeper into the atmosphere - beyond our reach.

descriptions.zh: 环绕[From.GetName]的众多卫星之一有一个终结轨道。它即将与气态巨行星相撞，这无疑会造成极大的破坏。这将是数百万年一遇的奇观，更巧合的是，这次撞击恰好在我们的一艘飞船拜访那里之后发生。许多科学家都想亲临现场观测和记录这次事件，但这样的碰撞转瞬即逝，因此留给我们的时间并不多。
descriptions.en:
One of the many moons circling [From.GetName] has a terminal orbit. It will soon collide with the gas giant in what is sure to become a massive impact event. This event has been millions of years in the making, and it is a startling coincidence that the impact has been fated to occur just after a visit by one of our ships.

Many of our scientists wish to observe and record the event, but we only have a narrow window before it is too late.

descriptions.zh: 我们成功的从不同角度记录了[CollisionLocation.GetName]和卫星相撞的奇观，并且对区域内的所有观众进行了现场直播。更重要的是，我们的科学家在[Root.GetLeaderName]的带领下记录了大量珍贵的物理数据，这对研究毫无疑问是有帮助的。
descriptions.en: We were successful in our attempt to record the collision between [CollisionLocation.GetName] and its moon! The event was captured from several different angles, and transmitted live throughout our space. Most importantly, our scientists under the leadership of [Root.GetLeaderName] were able to record a large amount of valuable physics data that will surely benefit our research.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详尽扫描表明这个星球在遥远的过去维持过生命。两极冰盖和[From.GetPlanetMoon]地表下明显蕴藏着冰冻水。干枯的河谷网的存在说明水曾经在星球表面自由流动。

对[From.GetPlanetMoon]环境改造理论上是可行的，但我们目前所拥有的科技并不足以在切合实际的时间内完成这一壮举。
descriptions.en:
Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that it may once have supported life in the distant past. There are significant deposits of frozen water at the polar ice caps and beneath the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. The existence of valley networks suggests that the water may once have flowed freely.

Terraforming this [From.GetPlanetMoon] would theoretically be possible, but we do not yet possess the technology to accomplish this monumental task within a realistic timeframe.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详尽扫描表明这个星球在遥远的过去维持过生命。两极冰盖和[From.GetPlanetMoon]地表下明显蕴藏着冰冻水。干枯的河谷网的存在说明水曾经在星球表面自由流动。

能量花费将令人生畏，但我们拥有将[From.GetPlanetMoon]逐渐环境改造成再次能维持生命的状态所必须的科技。
descriptions.en:
Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that it may once have supported life in the distant past. There are significant deposits of frozen water at the polar ice caps and beneath the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. The existence of valley networks suggests that the water may once have flowed freely.

The energy costs would be daunting, but we do have the technology to gradually terraform this [From.GetPlanetMoon] into something that would support life once again.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[From.GetName]的详尽扫描表明这个星球在遥远的过去维持过生命。两极冰盖和[From.GetPlanetMoon]地表下明显蕴藏着冰冻水。干枯的河谷网的存在说明水曾经在星球表面自由流动。

很不幸，这一恒星系中的§Y戴森球§!使得恢复行星环境不再可能。
descriptions.en:
Our detailed survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that it may once have supported life in the distant past. There are significant deposits of frozen water at the polar ice caps and beneath the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. The existence of valley networks suggests that the water may once have flowed freely.

Unfortunately the §YDyson Sphere§! in this system has removed any possibility of restoring the planet.

tooltips.en: §Y[From.GetName]§! will be able to be terraformed once the £society£ §HClimate Restoration§! technology has been researched.

label.zh: 总有一天它能被再度唤醒。
label.en: In time, perhaps we can reawaken it.

tooltips.en: §Y[From.GetName]§! will be able to be terraformed once the £society£ §HClimate Restoration§! technology has been researched.

descriptions.zh:
对[From.GetName]的表面细致勘探后我们发现了一个巨大撞击坑，其中散步着一些来历不明的古代舰船残骸碎片。这些舰船中似乎完全没有装配生命支持系统，我们推测它们可能是一些巨型无人机或者由某种人工智能操控。

这些舰船的船体材料颇为有趣，是由§H活性金属§!这种极其稀有的无机材料构造而成。这种材料属性多样而独特，可以被“编码”成特定形状，在受到损伤时，能够缓慢地自我修复。数千年过去，舰船上的活性金属逐渐熔化，形成了巨大、致密的矿脉，可供我们采集数个世纪。
descriptions.en:
Detailed surface scans of [From.GetName] have identified a large impact crater containing the wreckage of several ancient starships of unknown design. The ships appear to be completely devoid of life support systems, leading us to suspect that they were either unusually large drones or controlled by some form of artificial intelligence.

Interestingly, the hull of the ships was constructed out of §HLiving Metal§!, an exceedingly rare and inorganic material with many unique properties. This metal can be "programmed" to assume a certain shape or form, and it will slowly regrow itself if damaged. Over a period of several millennia, the surviving metal from the wrecked ships was fused into a large and extremely dense deposit that could potentially be mined for centuries to come.

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家在调查[From.GetName]上的早先文明的过程中，发现了一个神秘的小机器人试图隐藏自己。在对这个小东西经过数周的接近和示好之后，它终于将我们的科学家们带回到一个自它的创造者离去后起就由它照看的还在运作中的工厂。

被带到这座建筑之后，我们的人获赠了一大批可以带回飞船上的资源。尽管稀奇古怪难以沟通，但这个小机器人似乎把我们的科学家当成了自己的朋友。
descriptions.en:
As our scientists were looking into the earlier civilization on [From.GetName], they came across a small enigmatic robot trying to hide from them. Following weeks of approaching and befriending the little thing, it finally brought them back to a still-functional factory that it has been supervising since the demise of its creators.

After being guided to the building, our people were given a large quantity of resources they could bring back to their ship. Though weird and hard to communicate with, the little robot seems to think of our scientists as its friends.

descriptions.zh:
据[Root.GetName]的船员汇报，他们的任务失败了。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]心血来潮想手动操纵无人机采集矿石样本，结果不小心撞上了矿石，虽然撞击力度并不大，但矿石还是粉碎殆尽了。

船员还提到，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]对此十分内疚，并且那些粉碎的矿石还有些价值。
descriptions.en:
According to a report from the crew of the [Root.GetName], their mission was a failure. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] allegedly took manual control of the probe sent to retrieve a sample from the cluster, resulting in a collision between drone and mineral cluster that, while mild, resulted in the mineral cluster breaking apart completely.

The crew is careful to note that the experience has left Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] somewhat shaken, and the mineral shards should still be of some value.

label.zh: 碎了的矿石也还是矿石。
label.en: Its parts are equal to the sum of its parts.

descriptions.zh:
这块矿物的构造就像是个房间，没有其他更贴切的词能形容了。

构成房间的矿物在[Root.Owner.GetName]十分常用。这块矿石是中空的三十二面体，磁共振扫描显示其内部中空，很可能曾有人居住过。但是矿石内部与其光鲜的外表并不相同，看起来被人破坏的混乱不堪。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称由于这些破坏，我们很难从矿石内部找到有价值的信息。但其建筑的外部结构能够抵御深空压力，其构造技术一定十分先进。
descriptions.en:
The mineral construct is, for lack of a better term, a room.

Made out of the same type of minerals in common use in the [Root.Owner.GetName], the construct is a hollow icosidodecahedron. Resonance scans indicate that it is mostly hollow, and was likely inhabited at some point in time. Unlike its pristine exterior, the interior is in complete disarray, possibly the result of an intentional act of sabotage.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that this makes it difficult to learn anything of value from the construct's insides, but stresses that the engineering techniques involved in creating the outer shell, eminently capable of withstanding the stresses of deep space, must have been tremendously advanced.

descriptions.zh:
这块矿石是个全息记录仪，外表棱角分明，呈半透明状。其目前被安全地放置于[Root.GetName]的牵引光束中，但解码其内容仍需假以时日。

已经设立加速该进程的§Y特殊项目§!。
descriptions.en:
The mineral cluster is a holographic record, multi-sided, many-edged, and translucent. It remains secure in the [Root.GetName]'s tractor beam, but our experts will need some time to decode its contents.

A §YSpecial Project§! has been issued to expedite this process.

label.en: Nothing good would come of it.

descriptions.zh: 全息记录仪中的数据文档乃是一份曾经称霸此区域的三个大国之间的贸易协议。其中的内容我们无法理解也毫无意义，但科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这可以大大提高我们与外星人的沟通能力。
descriptions.en: The holographic data documents the terms and conditions for a trilateral trade treaty between three major alien powers that once dominated this quadrant of the galaxy. Context eludes us and the details are meaningless, but Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] feels that this find will prove invaluable to improving our own ability to communicate with alien forces.

descriptions.zh:
轨道上探查出的影像的确是建筑。进一步调查后发现建筑显然是用于军事用途。虽然被遗弃了一段时间——从星系尺度上看并不算久——但科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为从尘土下的废弃军营和空旷的军火库中仍然可以找到外星战术秘密。

已经设立了研究废墟的§Y特殊项目§!。
descriptions.en:
The silhouettes discernible from orbit are indeed buildings, and closer inspection reveal them to be of an obvious martial nature. While abandoned for some time - though very recently on a galactic timescale - Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] believes that secrets of alien tactics may yet be exhumed from beneath the dust that covers the decaying barracks and looted armories.

A §YSpecial Project§! may be issued to study the remains.

label.zh: 既然已经化为废墟，那就不要多管了。
label.en: That this outpost is dead and buried speaks volumes.

descriptions.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]对于[From.From.GetName]进行了详尽的外星历史分析，但最终结果不佳。该兵营早在行星变得贫瘠之前就被建立了，但不知是因为自然原因还是战争原因，才变成了今天这样的废墟。

可以得出的结论是：这些外星人使用的武器与战略并不比我们现在使用的要先进。

不过，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]说自己因为这次勘探，获取了不少灵感。
descriptions.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s thorough xeno-historical analysis of the military installation on [From.From.GetName] has yielded few tangible results. The base was constructed before the planet turned completely barren, but it is unclear if its current inhospitality is the result of armed conflict or some more peaceful or even natural process.

What can be deduced of their strategies and tactics in armed conflict does not seem to have been far in advance of our own.

On the upside, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] claims to have drawn much inspiration from the alien remnants.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]的特殊拓扑结构整齐地将星球划分为无数个不同的群落，各群落的气候以一种微妙的方式维持着周边环境的平衡。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]强烈怀疑这是先进的环境改造的结果，但我们无法解释这是如何做到的。

尽管如此，环境改造的结果对[Root.GetLeaderName]和[Root.GetName]的船员来说显而易见。
descriptions.en:
The unique topology of [From.GetName] neatly divides the planet into innumerable distinct biomes, micro-climates that interact only in subtle ways seemingly engineered to sustain neighboring climes. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] strongly suspects advanced terraforming techniques at work, but few clues remain regarding the process itself.

Its effects, however, remain plainly visible to [Root.GetLeaderName] and the [Root.GetName]'s crew.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]一处植被非常茂密的地域的中心发现了被植物掩盖的外星建筑，起初我们以为它已被摧毁，但经过[Root.GetName]仔细勘察发现，它还没有被这颗星球上格外茂盛的植物所侵蚀。

已发起§Y特殊项目§!来寻找建筑入口。
descriptions.en:
One of the major areas of extreme verdancy on [From.GetName] is centered on an overgrown alien structure. Initially thought ruined, closer observations by the [Root.GetName] reveal that the building has mostly survived the crushing embrace of the planet's flora.

A §YSpecial Project§! has been issued to find a way into the structure.

descriptions.zh:
这座杂草丛生的建筑是外星人的矿物加工厂。位于[From.From.GetName]的工厂尽管早已被废弃，但似乎曾基本实现了自动化，工厂的地上还躺着大量全自动机器人的残骸——他们的身体主要由有机化合物组成，体内以高分子内骨骼作为支撑，现在也一并腐烂了。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为正是这些有机残余物在液化后渗入了地面，使得土壤变得肥沃，星球上的各种植物也才会如此繁茂坚韧。

工厂可以被重新激活，但是[Root.GetLeaderName]感兴趣的那些迷人的，全自动的工人们却再也不能活过来了。
descriptions.en:
The overgrown structure - an alien mineral processing plant - on [From.From.GetName] was, prior to its abandonment in the distant past, mostly automated. Husks of artificial workers litter the floor, their organic components - for their bodies were largely of a biological nature, held upright by polymer endoskeletons - long since rotted away.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] speculates that it is the organic remains of these automatons that, soon liquefied and drained into the ground, provided an intense boost to soil nutrition and allowed the native flora to grow both abundant and resilient.

The plant can be reactivated but the automatons, fascinating as they may be to [Root.GetLeaderName], will never walk its halls again.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]的平原发现了一艘无人船只，其传感器对星球轨道上的[Root.GetName]做出了回应。

[Root.GetName]的船员未能确认此船何时被弃，也不知道此船是何人所弃。至于原船员的下落更是无从调查。根据科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]所说，若想将其收编入我方舰队，远程激活这艘轻装飞船应该不成问题。
descriptions.en:
There is a ship idling on the plains of [From.GetName], its sensors reacting to the [Root.GetName] in orbit around the planet.

The [Root.GetName]'s crew have been unable to confirm exactly when the craft was abandoned - for it is abandoned - or who left it there, or where they are now. According to Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], remotely activating the lightly armed ship would be trivial, should we wish to add it to our fleets.

label.en: No one will miss it, surely.

label.zh: 我们既不知道这是哪儿来的，也不知道这玩意要到哪儿去。拆掉吧。
label.en: We don't know whence it came or where it is going. Dismantle it.

descriptions.zh:
事实证明，荒芜的[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]毫无有趣之处。

当船员们监视着了无动静的仪器时，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]闲来无事查看了[Root.GetName]的能源储备情况。根据他们的报告，[Root.GetName]上次离港时获得的能量补给少于标准量，不过更有可能是[Root.GetLeaderName]对于资源管理的松懈造成了此次窘境。

不管怎么说，这艘船需要更多的能量作为补给。
descriptions.en:
The desert [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] turned out to be rather unremarkable.

While the crew monitored silent instruments, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] was idly eyeing the [Root.GetName]'s energy reserves. According to their report the [Root.GetName] was issued less than the standard amount of energy when it last left port, but is more likely that [Root.GetLeaderName]'s carefree approach to resource management is to blame for the deficit.

Regardless, the ship does need additional Energy Credits.

descriptions.zh:
事实证明，荒芜的[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]毫无有趣之处。

当船员们监视着了无动静的仪器时，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]对[Root.GetName]的能源储备进行了认真盘点。根据他们的报告，[Root.GetName]上次离港时获得的能量补给多于标准量，这很可能是书写错误造成的。

[Root.Leader.GetName]已提出要自愿将多余的能量交还给[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]当局。
descriptions.en:
The desert [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] turned out to be rather unremarkable.

While the crew monitored silent instruments, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] was conscientiously taking inventory of the [Root.GetName]'s energy reserves. According to their report the [Root.GetName] was issued more than the standard amount of energy when it last left port, probably due to some clerical error.

[Root.Leader.GetName] has volunteered to return the excess to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] authorities.

descriptions.zh:
我们误以为是矿物簇的物体实际上是两艘外星护卫舰的金属外壳，它们正悄悄飘过小行星带。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]已经与其建立联系，这两艘船的船员自称他们以前都是海盗，现在被首领放逐了。他们听说[Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle][Root.Owner.GetRulerName]是[Root.Owner.GetName]的统治者，为人亲民，特来寻求庇护。
descriptions.en:
What was thought to be a cluster of minerals are the metal hulls of two alien corvettes, stealthily drifting through the asteroid belt.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] established contact, and the two ships are crewed by alleged former pirates, now cast out from their robber-clan. They have heard whispers that [Root.Owner.GetRulerTitle] [Root.Owner.GetRulerName] of the [Root.Owner.GetName] is a champion of the people, and seek asylum.

descriptions.zh:
我们误以为是矿脉的物体实际上是两艘外星护卫舰的金属外壳，它们正悄悄飘过小行星带。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]已经与其建立联系，这两艘船的船员自称他们以前都是海盗，现在被匪帮首领放逐了。很神奇的是，他们相信我们会妥善对待他们，因此特来寻求庇护。
descriptions.en:
What was thought to be a cluster of minerals are the metal hulls of two alien corvettes, stealthily drifting through the asteroid belt.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] established contact, and the two ships are crewed by alleged former pirates, now cast out from their robber-clan. Curiously, they believe that we will be well-disposed towards them, and are seeking asylum.

label.zh: 我们不需要他们的帮忙。把他们的东西都没收，只留他们一条命吧。
label.en: We do not need their services. Take what they have but their lives.

label.zh: [Root.Owner.GetName]不能容忍他们这种家伙存在。
label.en: The [Root.Owner.GetName] will not suffer the existence of their kind.

label.zh: 我们必须拒绝他们的避难请求。
label.en: We must deny their asylum claim.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]遍布着此起彼伏的矿物复合带，用高耸且富有弹性的架子高悬于其本就十分崎岖的表面上。由于经常受到气流的扰动，摆动的架子和层叠的带状物互相摩擦，产生了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]无法听到的声波。

科研专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称将此声波从星球的背景噪音中分离出来时遇到了困难，同时也提出如果有意进行开采，建议将矿物带破坏，从而由[Root.Owner.GetName]进行回收利用。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName] is crisscrossed by overlapping mineral-composite bands that are elevated above the harsh surface by tall, flexible pylons. Constantly agitated by atmospheric winds, these pylons sway and the overlapping bands rub together to produce sonic waves at what are - to [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - inaudible frequencies.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports some difficulty in isolating this audio from the natural background noise of the planet, but notes that the mineral bands could - should we so choose - be broken down and efficiently recycled by the [Root.Owner.GetName].

label.zh: 将声音分离出来并进行研究。
label.en: Isolate and study the alien sounds.
Make preparations for salvaging the mineral bands.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]是一颗生态丰富的热带星球。对其表面植被的近距离分析却表明其生物异常缺乏多样性，一种特殊的高大树木成为了生态系统的主体部分。

虽说这种树木本身并不会造成什么危害，但其单一的主导地位却会对该星球小型动物的生存带来不利影响，若要进行殖民，想在其表面有效率地培育农作物也会异常困难。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]作为享有盛誉的外星生物学专家，制定了重新平衡此星球生态系统的计划。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName] is a tropical planet with a thriving biosphere. A close analysis of surface flora reveals an unexpected lack of diversity, as one particular family of tall trees dominate the ecosystem.

Though not harmful in and of themselves, their monocultural hegemony appears to have a detrimental effect on the survivability of the planet's small animals, and it would be difficult to efficiently cultivate food crops on the surface should colonization ever be attempted.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], a xeno-biologist of some repute, has put together a plan for re-balancing this alien biosphere.

descriptions.zh: 平衡已恢复了——或许是首次达到了。[Root.GetName]的放射射线消除了长久以来覆盖了这颗星球的那些多年生木本植物的繁殖能力。还有一些树木被彻底烧成了灰烬，以求尽快达到真正的平衡。
descriptions.en: Balance has been restored - or perhaps achieved for the first time - as large swathes of the dominant perennials have been rendered infertile by targeted radiation emissions from the [Root.GetName]. Additional specimens have been reduced to ash to further hasten the arrival of a truer equilibrium.

descriptions.zh:
激进地消灭一直以来覆盖着[From.From.GetName]的树木造成了意想不到的后果。

之前被这些树木搞得生计艰难的小动物们数量急剧上升，也越发富有攻击意愿——或者说是变得更加野蛮了。被隔离开来的焦土曾是茂密森林的所在，现在却成了领地争端的战场。
descriptions.en:
The inelegant elimination of wide swathes of the dominant trees on [From.From.GetName] have had unintended consequences.

The small animals that previously suffered under the perennial tyranny of the trees are growing both more plentiful and more aggressive - some would say savage. The isolated ashen fields that used to be home to lush forests now play host to heated territory battles.

label.zh: 也许我们本不该介入的。
label.en: Perhaps we should have known better than to meddle.

descriptions.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称，我们犯了个愚蠢的错误，在[From.GetName]沙漠看到的沙海涟漪其实是启动的飞船推进器造成的。

有一艘外星飞船头朝下埋没在沙海中，其断断续续工作的推进系统在上方的沙丘激起了阵阵波涛。看来这玩意已经困在这里有段时间了，它在推进器的作用下渐渐插进了沙丘深处。[Root.GetName]没有能够将此船吊出的设备与方法，[Root.GetLeaderName]建议派遣一只飞船到[From.GetName]，以对其进行发掘。
descriptions.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the waves seen rippling across the sandy seas of [From.GetName] are, bizarrely enough, the result of active ship thrusters.

An alien vessel lies buried in the sand nose-down, its sputtering propulsion systems weakly agitating the dunes above. It appears to have been down there for some time, slowly driving itself deeper into the desert dunes. The [Root.GetName] lacks the means to excavate the struggling ship, and [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends sending a military vessel to [From.GetName] to unearth it.

label.zh: 这么明显的陷阱，我们可不会上当。
label.en: We will not take the obvious bait.

label.zh: 任何剩余的有机生物都将被消灭。
label.en: If there are any organics left they will be terminated.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetFleetName]终于成功将外星飞船打捞了出来。

但它是空的，或者可以说，被拆的什么都没剩了。

原船员一定是将不是很重要的东西全拆掉后便弃船而去，留下这艘空壳在[From.From.GetName]沉没。[Root.GetFleetName]的工程师忙活了好一阵子，终于将其能量补充完毕并重启了飞船。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetFleetName] eventually succeeds in raising the submerged alien vessel.

It is empty. Almost stripped bare, in fact.

Its crew must have abandoned ship before it was left to burrow into the particulate surface of [From.From.GetName], and they took most of the ship's non-critical internals with them. The engineers of the [Root.GetFleetName] have managed to essentially hotwire the vessel, and have replenished its dwindling energy stores.

label.en: A fresh commission for the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] fleet.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetFleetName]使用高强度拉索最终成功打捞起了沉没的外星飞船，却同时也听到了其武器系统启动的轰鸣声！
descriptions.en: The [Root.GetFleetName]'s high-tensile wires eventually managed to raise the submerged alien vessel, only to be met by the recognizable whirring of weapons systems powering up!

descriptions.zh:
回收行动失败了。[Root.GetFleetName]绕在舰船上的高强度拉索在向上提拉时的瞬间就将腐蚀殆尽的舰体切成了数段。

单独的碎块回收起来还相对容易，但整个飞船已变成了废铁。
descriptions.en:
The salvage attempt failed. The high-tensile tethers that the [Root.GetFleetName] had wrapped around the burrowing ship effortlessly sliced through the vessel's corroded hull as raising was attempted.

The individual pieces were then relatively easy to retrieve, but the whole thing is reduced to scrap.

descriptions.zh:
一个拼凑的通讯中继器被很外行地绑在了[From.GetName]上。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为这是海盗通信网络的一部分。初步分析表明通信内容并不包含什么敏感的战术信息，只是些海盗船船员间的寻常通话。
descriptions.en:
A cobbled-together comms repeater has been inexpertly strapped to [From.GetName].

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is confident that this is part of a relay network for pirate communications. Initial analysis indicates that the messages relayed are not of a particularly strategically sensitive nature, but rather private inter-ship communications between individual crewmembers.

label.zh: 也许我们可以一窥深空的生活。
label.en: Perhaps we can learn something about life in deep space.

label.zh: 也许我们可以一窥深空的生活。
label.en: Perhaps we can learn something useful about life in deep space.

descriptions.zh:
读数来自于一个小型金属舱，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]判定这是一艘远古外星救生艇。

这东西显然是许久以前就被黑洞外围的引力井困在此处，因为角度问题无法弹射出来——至于这是故意为之还是偶然至此尚不得而知——救生艇的推进器从那时起就一直在竭力逃离黑洞视界。目前它已离黑洞视界太近，无法进行回收了。

[Root.GetLeaderName]的报告突然中断，随后[Root.GetName]船员发来通讯称，该科学专员浑身颤抖，似乎是对此救生艇的悲惨命运感到十分难过。
descriptions.en:
The readings originate from a small metal pod; Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has determined it to be a lifeboat of ancient and alien make.

Evidently caught on the outskirts of the black hole's gravity well eons ago, at an angle just short of a slingshot maneuver - whether this was the intent or happenstance is difficult to judge - and the pod's automated thrusters have been fighting its descent to the event horizon ever since. It is now too close to the horizon to salvage.

[Root.GetLeaderName]'s report ends abruptly, and the crew of the [Root.GetName] communicate that the Science Officer appears shaken and deeply troubled by the tragic fate of the lifeboat.

descriptions.zh:
读数来自于一个小型金属舱，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]判定这是一艘远古外星救生艇。

这东西显然是许久以前就被黑洞外围的引力井困在此处，因为角度问题无法弹射出来——至于这是故意为之还是偶然至此尚不得而知——救生艇的推进器从那时起就一直在竭力逃离黑洞视界。目前它已离黑洞视界太近，无法进行回收了。

[Root.GetLeaderName]的报告突然中断，随后[Root.GetName]船员发来通讯称，该科学专员似乎深受这一新数据的影响，因其已显著改变了[Root.GetName]的风险评估统计与生存率预测。
descriptions.en:
The readings originate from a small metal pod; Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has determined it to be a lifeboat of ancient and alien make.

Evidently caught on the outskirts of the black hole's gravity well eons ago, at an angle just short of a slingshot maneuver - whether this was the intent or happenstance is difficult to judge - and the pod's automated thrusters have been fighting its descent to the event horizon ever since. It is now too close to the horizon to salvage.

[Root.GetLeaderName]'s report ends abruptly, and the crew of the [Root.GetName] communicate that the Science Officer appears deeply affected by this new data, as it has significantly altered the [Root.GetName]'s risk assessment statistics and survival rate predictions.

descriptions.zh:
惊人的是，此系统获取的数据居然是来自[From.GetName]本身。

作为黑洞来说，其体积较小，似乎可以解释为何会有辐射从其视界逃逸出来。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为此黑洞正在崩解，不久便会消失，但很难说这个过程会不会在宇宙的热寂之前完成。

用[Root.GetLeaderName]的话说，黑洞幼年期受到的重力扰动搞得它“动荡不安”，从而进一步加强了其视界流出的能源。
descriptions.en:
The readings picked up in the this system come - somewhat surprisingly - from [From.GetName] itself.

As black holes go it is fairly small, which could account for some of the unexpected radiation leaking from its event horizon. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] believes that the black hole is on its way to "bleeding out" and will eventually disappear entirely - though it is difficult to say whether this process would be complete before the heat death of the universe.

Some gravitational upset in the hole's youth has rendered it - to quote [Root.GetLeaderName] - "wobbly," further increasing the flow of energy from its event horizon.

label.zh: 我们可以从中学到很多东西。
label.en: There is much we could learn.

descriptions.zh:
虽说[From.GetName]上的大部分建筑都已成废墟，但还有少数得以留存。[Root.GetName]初次经过该星球时只发现了一座还算完整的建筑，孤零零地耸立在[From.GetName]的废墟之中。

这便是噪音的来源。

该建筑不仅结构完整，据科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]称，似乎还存在活动迹象。

那是一座生产设施，专门将塑料聚合物制成不明的物体，不过似乎是用于装饰的。其生产原料与最终产品对[Root.Owner.GetName]来说没有研究价值，但我们可以对其自动化的生产过程进行研究。
descriptions.en:
There are structures on [From.GetName], though most are less than ruins and more akin to rubble. The [Root.GetName]'s initial pass over the planet reveals only one building that can be considered intact, seemingly spared whatever calamity robbed [From.GetName] of its buildings and builders alike.

This is the source of the noise.

Not only is the building intact, reports Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], but it is active.

It is a production facility of some sort, turning plasticine polymers into mute objects of uncertain, but possibly ornamental, purpose. The raw materials and end product are largely uninteresting to the [Root.Owner.GetName], but we could doubtlessly stand to learn something from the automated manufacturing process itself.

label.zh: 也许我们应该建立据点并进行观察。
label.en: Perhaps we should establish a foothold and observe.

descriptions.zh:
巨大的[From.GetName]周围的缓轨道上漂浮着一个可移动的数据库。[Root.GetName]将其打捞后发现其中似乎包含某种外星语言写就的内容。其词汇组成并非完全陌生，但其语法则是十分复杂。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]建议对其进行进一步研究，以便解密该文本的内容与起源。
descriptions.en:
In gentle orbit around the massive [From.GetName] floats a portable databank. Scooped up by the [Root.GetName], it is found to contain text in some alien language. The vocabulary is not wholly unfamiliar, but the syntax is disconcertingly complex.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends a more thorough study to decipher the text's contents and origins.

options.script: name = anomaly.3085.b

descriptions.zh:
该文本的标题大致可以译为“地区统治者”，通篇似乎是以[book_writer.GetSpeciesAdj]古方言写就，该方言一般使用于[book_writer.GetName]。

内容无疑对他们具有一定历史价值，搞不好还能带来些什么启发。
descriptions.en:
The text - its title roughly translates to "Regional Ruler" - is written in a presumably ancient dialect of the [book_writer.GetSpeciesAdj] tongue spoken in the [book_writer.GetName].

The text is doubtlessly of some historical import to them, and might contain valuable insights.

label.zh: 这秘密还是不要说出去了——不需要让他们知道的。
label.en: Let us divine its secrets - they need not know.

label.zh: 我们要物归原主。联络他们。
label.en: We will return it to its proper owners. Hail them.

label.zh: 他们的文笔如此空洞，思维自然也不堪一击。联络他们。
label.en: Their prose is pedestrian, their ideas weak. Hail them.

descriptions.zh:
我们听说你找到了《君主论》的最后一份拷贝。这可是我们社会十分重要的历史文化遗产。
我们曾以为它已在多年前的海盗袭击中被毁掉了，但它如今能落入文明人的手中，我们倍感欣慰。

可以将其交还给我们吗？我们会以能量币作为报酬。
descriptions.en:
We understand that you have found the only surviving copy of "The Prince," a text of significant historical and cultural importance to our people.
We thought it irrevocably lost to a pirate raid years ago, but we are grateful to see that it found its way into civilized hands.

Will you return it to us? We will gladly transfer some Energy Credits for your trouble.

descriptions.zh:
我们听说你找到了《君主论》的最后一份拷贝。这可是我们社会十分重要的历史文化遗产。

我们曾以为它已在多年前的海盗袭击中被毁掉了，但它如今能落入文明人的手中，我们倍感欣慰。

可以将其交还给我们吗？
descriptions.en:
We understand that you have found the only surviving copy of "The Prince," a text of significant historical and cultural importance to our people.

We thought it irrevocably lost to a pirate raid years ago, but we are grateful to see that it found its way into civilized hands.

Will you return it to us?

label.zh: 不。说起来，我们认为这东西不怎么样。
label.en: No. In fact, we think it is bad.

label.zh: 不。这些文字正是骗子的工具。
label.en: No. The written word is the tool of liars.

label.zh: 带着你的书一起下地狱吧。
label.en: You and your words will be destroyed.

descriptions.zh:
绝不容许你批判我们的文学！

你们会后悔的！
descriptions.en:
You can't criticize our literature!

You will regret this!

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]和缓的运行轨道上竟漂浮着一枚紧急信标。其外壳已被严重损坏，似乎是被武器火力击中或是被大爆炸波及。

这似乎是来自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的民用飞船专属型号——用于在通讯系统故障时作为紧急措施进行发射——但其受损的严重程度使具体情况都不得而知了。

它一直在重复一个微弱而失真的信号。
descriptions.en:
An emergency transmission buoy floats in gentle orbit around [From.GetName]. Its outer casing is heavily damaged, seemingly by glancing weapons fire or a powerful explosion.

It might be a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] model for civilian ships - designed to be ejected as an emergency measure should the comms systems fail - but the extent of the damage makes it impossible to know for certain.

It is repeating a weak, distorted signal.

label.zh: 也许是陷阱——最好不要以身犯险。
label.en: It could be a trap - best leave it be.

options.script: name = anomaly.3090.b

descriptions.zh: 信标已确定来自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]，其发射的信号已趋于稳定。
descriptions.en: The buoy has been verified as one of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] make, and the signal it's relaying has been stabilized.

label.zh: 这里是[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国。请亮明身份。
彻底关掉。这件事到此为止。
label.en: Shut it down. No one is to speak of this.

descriptions.zh:
有、有人吗？这里是[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]民用运输船“卢克西昂号”的舰长。

啊，应该说是前舰长。卢克西昂已经不复存在了。我们被海盗登船，我们在飞船爆炸前就被掳走成了人质。
descriptions.en:
He- hello? This is the captain of the Luxion, a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] civilian transport.

Uh, former captain. The Luxion is gone. We were boarded by pirates and taken captive before they blew up the ship.

descriptions.zh:
什么？什么？！你们不能见死不救！

要是他们认为不能用我们向[Root.GetName]索取赎金的话，绝对会连眼都不眨就宰了我们的！就连真的付了赎金的话我们的性命也没有保障啊！你们不能——
descriptions.en:
What? What? You can't. You can't not save us!

If they get it into their heads that they won't be able to ransom us back to the [Root.GetName] they won't hesitate to kill us. They'll probably kill us even if the ransom is paid! You can't--

options.script: name = anomaly.3093.a

descriptions.zh:
哦，真是太感谢了，太感谢了啊！[Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们似乎被关在某个空间站，但具体位置我也不知道。

我这就加强传输频率，你们应该可以通过紧急信标进行三角测量，确认我们被绑架的位置……
descriptions.en:
Oh thank you! Thank you, [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We're being held in some space station, but I have no idea where we are beyond that.

I will increase the transmission burst now, it should let you triangulate the location of this prison from the emergency buoy...

label.zh: 位置已记录于情报日志。
label.en: Position recorded in the Situation Log.

descriptions.zh:
虽说海盗的基地十分隐蔽，但若知道如何寻找的话就十分明显了。

一支舰队排着奇怪的队形慢慢从重新运行的采矿设施后慢悠悠飘了出来——显然是并没想到会有不速之客。
descriptions.en:
The pirate base, while fairly inconspicuous, is obvious when you know what to look for.

A fleet in confused formation slowly drifts out from behind the re-purposed mining complex - they were obviously not expecting company.

label.zh: 打开通讯系统。必须让被囚者做好准备。
label.en: Open comms. The captives need to be ready.

descriptions.zh:
你好啊，[Root.GetRulerTitle]。看来这一切都是因为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的飞船而起的了？

我们好客的主人们似乎即将离开他们当前的位置。登上这地方对各方都不利，但是……如果你直接对基地发起攻击，我觉得我们倒是可以拼一拼，看看能不能弄到一艘救生艇。

我们出来的时候可别把我们给炸飞了！
descriptions.en:
Hello again, [Root.GetRulerTitle]. I take it [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] ships are the cause of all this commotion?

Our hosts seem about ready to leave their posts. Boarding this place would probably end badly for everyone involved, but... If you attack the base directly, I think we can make a break for one of the lifeboats.

Please try not to blow us up on our way out!

titles.zh: 星际绑架者：尘归尘，土归土

descriptions.zh: 索取赎金的海盗们的基地被摧毁了，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的俘虏们也一道消失了。俘虏们似乎成功联系到了发动进攻的外星飞船，却被对方忽视了。
descriptions.en: The Ransomeer pirate base has been destroyed, and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] prisoners along with it. It appears the captives managed to hail the alien ships that attacked, but were ignored.

label.zh: 我们绝不会忘记这个悲剧。
label.en: We will never forget this tragedy.

titles.zh: 星际绑架者：意外的救星

descriptions.zh:
[From.From.GetName]的战斗行动彻底摧毁了星际绑架者的部队。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏在交战中成功逃出，目前已登上一艘救生艇，即将与[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]救援飞船接头。
descriptions.en:
Military action by the [From.From.GetName] has destroyed the Ransomeer forces.

The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] captives made a successful escape attempt during the attack, and are now safely on board a lifeboat well on its way to be a rendezvous [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] rescue vessels.

descriptions.zh:
不知何方发起的战斗行动彻底摧毁了星际绑架者的部队。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏们奇迹般地逃出生天，在攻击行动中偷去了一艘救生艇，即将返回[Root.Capital.GetName]。
descriptions.en:
Military action by an unknown force destroyed the Ransomeer pirates.

Miraculously, the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] captives managed to break out and steal a lifeboat during the attack, and are now well on their way back to [Root.Capital.GetName].

label.zh: 真是神秘而偶然的遭遇啊。

titles.en: The Ransomeers: Picking Up the Pieces

descriptions.zh:
海盗的基地在我方飞船造成的连锁效应中缓慢地分崩离析。与此同时，我们开始了对卢克西昂号生还者的搜索。

如果他们真的上了救生艇，现在也该联络我们了……
descriptions.en:
As the pirate base slowly tears itself apart in a savage chain reaction instigated by our military vessels, the search for the captive crew of the Luxion begins.

If they made it to a lifeboat, they should be attempting to hail us by now...

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，这里是卢西安号的船员。

计划进行得十分顺利。在你们展开对基地的袭击后，卫兵们都跑上船了，于是我们也成功破坏了囚室大门。救生艇无人看守，看来你们给这群海盗造成了不小的麻烦，完全没人注意到我们逃跑了。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetRulerTitle], this is the crew of the Luxion.

The plan went off without a hitch. Once you started bombarding the base directly, the guards took to their ships, and we were able to break down the cell door. The lifeboats were unguarded, and it seems you kept the pirates busy enough that they did not care much about our escape.

descriptions.zh:
被关押的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]最终未能逃出海盗基地。我们并未能确认他们到底是如何死亡的——是救生艇未能成功发射，还是他们压根没有逃出囚室——但这不妨碍我们确认他们已死亡的事实。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]们一定会十分感激[Root.GetName]的[Root.GetRulerTitle]采取的迅速行动，但感觉他们短时间内也不会遗忘这出惨剧。
descriptions.en:
The kidnapped [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] never made it off the pirate base. We are unable to determine exactly where they met their end - if the lifeboat failed to launch, or if they never made it out of their holding cell - but fact remains that they are dead.

The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people are sure to appreciate the swift actions undertaken by the [Root.GetRulerTitle] of the [Root.GetName], but they are also unlikely to soon forget this tragedy.

descriptions.zh:
卢克西昂号的船员安全的回到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，一场灾难就此避免，[Root.GetName]的[Root.GetRulerTitle]的果断行动让[Root.GetAdj]人民十分自豪。

海盗的绑架勒索事件已经成功划上句点，海盗团也被消灭了，但还有一些事没搞清楚，比如被俘虏的人声称他们在被抓后曾经从飞船窗口中看到了更大型的海盗舰队。从目前情况来看，可以确定威胁比我们实际看到的还要大的多。

进行这次勒索行动的家伙们已经被处理了。
descriptions.en:
With the crew of the Luxion safely on their way back to [Root.Capital.GetName], disaster has been averted. The [Root.GetAdj] people are sure to glory in the decisive actions of the [Root.GetName]'s [Root.GetRulerTitle].

The situation with the kidnapping Ransomeer pirates, as well as the pirate band itself, has come to an end. Some questions remain, mainly relating to the much larger piratical navy the captives claim to have seen through portholes shortly after their capture. But, considering the circumstances, it can safely be assumed that the threat appeared to be much greater than it actually was.

The Ransomeers are over and done with.

descriptions.zh:
不出所料，[Root.GetName]成功定位了[From.GetName]信号的来源。

虽说整颗星球看似完全未被外星生物开发过，不过星球南半球一座山丘顶部却发现了一座光滑的白色矿物柱体。信号正是从该柱体中发出，柱体也明显是为了避免共振而设计。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]已停下手边工作，开始筹备§Y特殊项目§!，以期能够解密该信号携带的信息。
descriptions.en:
As expected, the [Root.GetName] has located the source of the transmission emanating from [From.GetName].

While the planet is otherwise seemingly untouched by alien hands, a lone monolith of some sleek off-white mineral stands atop a hill in the southern hemisphere. It is from within this monument that the signal emerges, the enclosure clearly built for longevity rather than resonance.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has gone out of their way to establish the parameters for a §YSpecial Project§! that would decode the information the signal carries.

label.zh: 死人的话有什么好听的。
label.en: We have little to gain by listening to the dead.
Raze the monument, find the transmitter.

descriptions.zh:
我们原以为所发现的巨石只是发射器的保护性外壳，但事实并非如此。

在被单独取出后，发射器本身毫无用处。已被摧毁的巨石有某种内部结构，能够使其运转。现在我们已经无法恢复其功能了。
descriptions.en:
We believed the monolith to be only a protective housing for the transmitter, but we were wrong.

The transmitter, once isolated, turned out to be useless on its own. Something about the internal structure of the now-razed monolith made it work, and we have no hope of restoring its function.

options.script: name = anomaly.3111.a

descriptions.zh: 出人意料，巨石很轻易地就被解体。与最初的猜想相反，其中心的小型发射器为巨石的矿质结构供能，使得信号发射得以进行。
descriptions.en: The monolith disassembles with surprising ease. Contrary to earlier assumptions, the tiny transmitter at its center energizes the mineral structure of the monolith, enabling the transmission.

label.zh: 很不幸，这算不上什么新闻。

descriptions.zh:
科学专员[From.GetLeaderName]报告称[From.From.GetName]发出的信号已经解密完成了。

这是一段记录性质的信息，记载了千年前一场造成数百人死亡的战斗。一支原本坚定的联盟由于背叛与欺骗最终分崩离析，他们的大型舰队在敌人到来之前就自相残杀殆尽。

看来这些残骸作为墓碑被保留在了这里。敌人精准地命中了舰体的弱点，而船员们在那个时候就被消灭了。
descriptions.en:
Science Officer [From.GetLeaderName] reports that the signal broadcast by the transmission beacon on [From.From.GetName] has been decoded.

It is a memorial message, decrying the loss of hundreds of lives in a battle millennia past. A stalwart alliance apparently fell victim to treachery and deceit, and a massive fleet wiped itself out before the enemy had even arrived, as ally turned on ally.

Apparently these desiccated hulks were left in place as floating grave-markers, the crews having been destroyed by surgical strikes to weak points in their ships' hulls.

label.zh: 计算舰队残骸的轨道与当前位置。
label.en: Calculate the wrecked fleet's trajectory and current position.

descriptions.zh:
到达[From.GetName]星系后，显而易见，[Root.GetName]来得太迟了。

不久前一支来路不明的海盗舰队发现了这片战场并将其拆除，用所得的材料在附近一颗小行星上建立了基地。

我们的研究宣告结束，看来一场好斗冲突已不可避免。
descriptions.en:
Upon arriving in the [From.GetName] system, it becomes clear that the [Root.GetName] is too late.

A pirate fleet of unknown origin discovered the straying battlefield some time ago, and cannibalized it to build a base on a nearby asteroid.

Our search ends, as a violent confrontation seems unavoidable.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]已找到了[From.GetName]星系内漂移的残骸。信息中提到的飞船许多已在长年侵蚀下化为尘埃，但仍有少数保存得相当完整。

其中有六艘可以让工程师进行抢修。

打开§Y情报日志§!以查看详情。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located the drifting wrecks in the [From.GetName] system. Many of the ships referenced in the memorial beacon message have been reduced to dust and ashes over the centuries, but a few still remain remarkably intact.

Between them, six military vessels should have enough engineers to restore the better-preserved hulks to working order.

Consult the §YSituation Log§! for details.

descriptions.zh:
部分古代舰队残骸已恢复运转，尽管派去的工程师无法对如何完成这一点达成一致。

舰队已经收编入[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]舰队。
descriptions.en:
The ancient rag-tag armada has been partially resurrected, although the dispatched engineers cannot agree on exactly how this feat was accomplished.

The vessels have been commissioned into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] fleets.

descriptions.zh: 威胁已被终结。或许，我们至少能部分利用起被海盗抢走的古老科技。
descriptions.en: The threat is ended. We might, at least, be able to make some use of the ancient technology the pirates plundered.

descriptions.zh:
该轨道站似乎曾作为小行星的矿物开采与加工中心使用，设计上与我们的开采站有些许相似。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为派出几位工程师——最好是已经驻扎在飞船上的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——也许就可以使其恢复运转。
descriptions.en:
The orbital station appears to have once functioned as a mineral extraction and processing center for the asteroid, not wholly dissimilar from our own mining station designs.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] expects that a handful of engineers - ideally [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] already stationed on military vessels - just might be able to restore the station to working order.

label.zh: 我们对异种残骸没有兴趣。
label.en: We have no interest in xeno wreckage.

label.zh: 我们重建这个太空港吧。

descriptions.zh: 工程师们完成了任务，使用改装过的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]部件与控制机制翻修了这座破旧的开采站。
descriptions.en: The engineering corps completed their mission, retrofitting the decrepit mining station with adapted [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] parts and control mechanisms.

descriptions.zh:
工程师们完成了任务，使用改装过的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]部件与控制机制翻修了这座破旧的开采站。

对于这个空间站最初的功能我们仍然还有很多不了解的地方。看来这里最初用于开采和精炼某些其它的资源，而非我们所感兴趣的矿物生产。以上推测还需进一步调查才能确认。
descriptions.en:
The engineering corps completed their mission, retrofitting the decrepit mining station with adapted [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] parts and control mechanisms.

There remain some aspects of the station's original function that are not entirely clear to us. It appears the manufactory was originally intended to mine and refine something other than the production minerals we are interested in. This bears further investigation.

descriptions.zh:
工程师们完成了任务，使用改装过的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]部件与控制机制翻修了这座破旧的开采站。

我们接到报告，从工厂的加工室中回收到某种未知物质——也许这个开采站曾经开采并精炼过我们从没见过的矿物。
descriptions.en:
The engineering corps completed their mission, retrofitting the decrepit mining station with adapted [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] parts and control mechanisms.

We have received reports of an unknown substance recovered from the manufactory's processing chambers - it is possible that the station once mined and refined something other than the minerals we concern ourselves with.

label.zh: 还有很多值得研究的地方。
label.en: There is much we can learn.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]工程师们的探索一无所获。这个太空港过于破旧，已无法再次启动，很多建筑结构在尝试启动时就直接崩塌了。

在工厂坍塌的同时，有什么东西从地底下爬了出来——它们用高能激光器切开了一条通路，直勾勾地瞪着[Root.GetFleetName]。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] engineers' prodding and probing has proven fruitless. The station is too dilapidated to bring online, large sections of the structure simply collapsing under the strain of attempted reactivation.

As the manufactory's structural integrity finally failed, something, some things, emerged from its depths - cutting their way out with high-powered lasers and setting their sights on the [Root.GetFleetName].

descriptions.zh:
老旧的石层破开，有什么东西涌了出来。

完全不是预想中光洁的矿石，尖利的锯齿状晶体边缘切碎了破旧的轨道站，随后又将注意力转向了[Root.GetFleetName]。
descriptions.en:
As the old rock tumblers spin up, something spills out.

Far from the polished mineral ore expected, jagged crystal edges shred the decrepit orbital station before turning their attention to the [Root.GetFleetName].

descriptions.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]报告称[From.GetPlanetMoon][From.GetName]上确实存在过较为发达的文明，但还没来得及飞出[From.GetPlanetMoon]便自行消亡了。通过分析从星球表面取回的古代无线通讯站碎片，[Root.GetName]的船员逐渐还原了整个文明消逝的过程。

在很久以前的某个时间点，该文明的看法分裂为两派，也就是我们今天所说的集体主义与个人主义。虽说这些哲学上的争论与[Root.Owner.GetName]人们的生活并没有什么太大关系，但这个文明却因不知采用何种意识形态和道德标准而最终分崩离析。
descriptions.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.GetName] was indeed once home to a somewhat advanced civilization, although one that brought about its own end before escaping [From.GetPlanetMoon]bound existence. By analyzing the few fragments that could be recovered from the ancient wireless information depots on the surface, the crew of the [Root.GetName] have pieced together the narrative of the civilization's demise.

At some point in the distant past, an ideological schism developed over the definitions of the philosophies we today know as collectivism and individualism. While the relevance of these philosophies seems highly questionable to the people of the [Root.Owner.GetName], this civilization evidently tore itself apart over the question of which moral stances should be attributed to which ideology.

descriptions.zh:
从荒芜的[From.GetName]星球回来时，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]带回来了一张用植物纤维做成的针织物。虽然不清楚其来历和用途，但是实验证明了此物的吸水性极好。虽然此物对科学研究毫无帮助，不过[Root.GetLeaderName]却对它情有独钟，无论去哪里都把该物品随身携带。

“[Root.GetLeaderName]真是个奇人。”船员们私底下评论道。
descriptions.en:
Returning from the desolate surface of [From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] brings with them a sheet of woven plant fiber. Its exact origin and purpose is unknown, but it has proven quite absorbent in tests. While useless to the sciences, [Root.GetLeaderName] has taken a shine to the thing and now carries it with them wherever they go.

"Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is a real hoopy frood," the crew whisper.
